title: Getinge Extended Health Care Limited - proposed acquisition of Huntleigh Technology PLC

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines
ACCC timeline suspended pending further information from Getinge
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC announced its decision not to oppose the acquisition

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the following markets: - the national market for the manufacture and supply of air pressure mattresses used in the prevention    and treatment of pressure ulcers; and - the national market for the manufacture and supply of patient lifting devices. The competition assessment in this instance would not have changed if a broader product market was adopted.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC decided not to oppose the proposed acquisition on the basis that imports and the countervailing power of consumers - that is, distributors, hospitals, nursing homes and aged care facilities would be likely to constrain the merged firm. No substantial lessening of competion was likely.
